subject: mathematics
content: Let a plane P pass through the point (3, 7, $$-$$7) and contain the line, $${{x - 2} \over { - 3}} = {{y - 3} \over 2} = {{z + 2} \over 1}$$. If distance of the plane P from the origin is d, then d<sup>2</sup> is equal to ______________.
